record.paper_title: Vector bundles on curves and generalized theta functions: recent results and open problems
record.context_brief: Unitary structure on generalized theta spaces
record.original_question: For the flat projective bundle over the moduli of curves whose fiber over X is H^0(SU_X(r), L^k), does there exist a flat Hermitian metric H_X on H^0(SU_X(r), L^k) such that the image of the associated mapping class group representation ρ_{r,k} is contained in PU(H_X)?

evidence.quote: Conformal Field Theory predicts that the connection should be (projectively) unitary.
Q 8. – Find a flat hermitian metric H_X on H0(SU_X(r), L^k) (i.e. such that the image of ρ_{r,k} is contained in PU(H_X) ).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathcal{M}_g$ denote the moduli space of smooth projective complex curves of genus $g \geq 2$. For a smooth projective curve $X$ of genus $g$, let $SU_X(r)$ denote the moduli space of semistable rank-$r$ vector bundles on $X$ with trivial determinant, and let $\mathcal{L}$ be the ample generator of $\mathrm{Pic}(SU_X(r)) \cong \mathbb{Z}$ (the determinant line bundle). For a positive integer $k$ (the level), consider the finite-dimensional complex vector space of generalized (non-abelian) theta functions
$$V_X := H^0(SU_X(r), \mathcal{L}^{\otimes k}).$$
As $X$ varies, these spaces form a holomorphic vector bundle $\mathcal{V}_{r,k}$ over $\mathcal{M}_g$ (and over Teichmüller space $\mathcal{T}_g$), which carries a natural flat projective connection (the Hitchin connection). Parallel transport with respect to this connection induces a projective representation of the mapping class group $\mathrm{Mod}_g = \pi_1(\mathcal{M}_g)$:
$$\rho_{r,k}: \mathrm{Mod}_g \longrightarrow PGL(V_X).$$

Question: Does there exist, for each $X$, a Hermitian inner product $H_X$ on $V_X$ that is flat with respect to the Hitchin connection (equivalently, varies in a parallel manner with $X$), so that the image of $\rho_{r,k}$ is contained in the projective unitary group $PU(V_X, H_X)$?
artifact.category_tag: Hitchin connection and generalized theta functions
artifact.status_search_result: The projective unitarity of the Hitchin/KZ connection on bundles of generalized (non-abelian) theta functions has been established. Ramadas proved unitarity of the KZ/Hitchin connection on conformal blocks in genus 0, and Andersen (2012, arXiv:1206.2635) established mapping-class-group-invariant unitarity of the Hitchin connection over Teichmüller space, constructing a geometric Hermitian structure projectively preserved by the connection. Thus a flat Hermitian metric $H_X$ exists with $\mathrm{Im}(\rho_{r,k}) \subset PU(H_X)$.

status_evidence.title: Mapping class group invariant unitarity of the Hitchin connection over Teichmüller space
status_evidence.snippet: A geometric construction of the unitary structure which is projectively preserved by the Hitchin connection.
status_evidence.claim: Andersen constructs a Hermitian structure projectively preserved by the Hitchin connection, yielding unitary mapping class group representations.

status_evidence.title: The Harder-Narasimhan trace and unitarity of the KZ/Hitchin connection
status_evidence.snippet: Unitarity of the KZ/Hitchin connection on conformal blocks.
status_evidence.claim: Ramadas established unitarity of the KZ/Hitchin connection.
